message:
As we navigate the little surprises that life throws our way, it’s easy to chuckle at the comedy of not being ready. Remember that one time we thought we’d never need extra batteries until the storm hit? 😅

The truth is, preparing ourselves and our kiddos for unexpected moments can be both practical and fun! 

Check out this resource on how to get our little ones involved in the preparedness journey. Together, we can turn what might feel like a daunting task into a family adventure. 

So, what’s one small step we can take today to be a little more ready for tomorrow?
